examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Blog list at rest. Pick a category or type in the search field to narrow it; when nothing matches, the list and its button are left out. WebKit ships no editorial media, so the covers here are the neutral `@aziontech/webkit/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.

site.name: AllArticles
site.summary: The Blog page's list at rest: All articles selected and no search, rows in the byline layout, and the load-more button. WebKit ships no editorial media, so the covers here are the neutral `@aziontech/webkit/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.
